subject: What I saw overnight
body:
I was working late in Programs. At 00:01 Kofi and I saw a pale figure through the server-room glass. It ran and we followed it toward the fire stairs. We lost sight of it at 00:03.

We were at the lobby phone calling facilities from 00:04 to 00:19. I couldn't identify anyone. I'm writing this down before the times get muddled in another retelling. Sandra
